decision: Use real Flight 15 catch footage (SpaceX webcast as re-uploaded by The Launch Pad on YouTube, JLo08HUO2aY) for the hook and flight scenes instead of the 2024 Commons photos: 23 s, muted, cropped.
rationale: Owner instruction in conversation: 'download from somewhere with yt-dlp, it will be a 20-30s max'. Claude flagged beforehand that the footage is SpaceX's under YouTube's standard licence (not CC), so it does not meet the monetised-reuse rule and risks a copyright claim; the owner chose to use it. Short, muted excerpt with narration and on-screen credit.
alternatives: ask The Launch Pad for permission
wait for CC footage on Commons
